scope: FP16 decoder fused FFN-up/SwiGLU GROUP_M launch-order exploration; operator replay only.
decision: Not promoted to production or a new full-decoder performance claim.

current_full_stage_reference.meaning: Previously validated separate modes; unchanged by this investigation and not additive.

measurement_contract.input_origin: Actual FP16 decoder captures, transformer layers 0/17/35 at batch8 and batch4 tail shapes.
measurement_contract.dtype: FP16 inputs/weights/output, FP32 accumulation; original FP16 linear rounding and FP32 SwiGLU arithmetic retained.
measurement_contract.sample_order: Rotate implementation order and reverse on odd rounds; retain every sample.
measurement_contract.timer: CUDA Event ms plus host wall_s; operator calls allocate output; CPU correctness copies are outside timing.
measurement_contract.graph_boundary: Unchanged during capture; local replay calls production/candidate operator directly.

conclusion: GROUP_M=4 has small mean reductions (0.06%-2.38%) in this single local replay, while one tail-shape median regresses. GROUP_M=1/16/32 are slower. No full-stage timing or quality validation was run for the candidate; existing published FP16 decoder latency stays unchanged.
raw_report_hash_note: Hashes identify original private capture/replay reports before path redaction; no captured tensors or model weights are included.
